_comment: BDS 1.26.51.1. Constructors and destructors found from the vftable they store (tools/ctor-from-vftable.mjs, docs/findings-instances.md "Constructors from held tables"): every referencing function of a held table is a constructor, a destructor or a caller that inlined one, and the candidate is the one whose body matches the PDB-named 1.21.3.01 body instruction for instruction -- same field offsets, same constants, same callee shape -- with the alloc-failure path and, on 1.26.40.8, the UUID generation inlined. Never hook targets (merge-symbols.mjs does not trust this source for hooks). Names that also fired under a counter probe are in data/resolved-1.26.51.1.json instead.

called by the named ?clone@VirtualCommandOrigin@@ (0x120f260), as on 1.26.40.8 and in the baseline.
